item.title: Why Bethel’s Finder’s Ministry and Dan McCollum’s “Prophetic Training” Are Not Biblical
item.description: In this episode of NAR to Christ, Dawn Hill examines Bethel’s Finder’s Ministry and Dan McCollum’s prophetic training, exposing how these practices rely on mysticism and New Age methods rather than the authority and sufficiency of Scripture.

item.title: For Such a Time as This, God’s Providential Call in Esther 4
item.description: A Christmas Day episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, examining Esther 4 and God’s providential call to courageous obedience, pointing to Christ’s perfect intercession.

item.title: The Word Became Flesh: Celebrating the Incarnation of Christ
item.description: On this Christmas Day episode, Dave Jenkins reflects on the Incarnation—Jesus, the eternal Word made flesh—revealing God’s presence, grace, truth, and glory.

item.title: Psalm 123: Lifting Our Eyes to God for Mercy
item.description: A sermon from Psalm 123 in the Walking Through the Psalms series. Dave Jenkins teaches on lifting our eyes to the Lord, waiting on His mercy, and trusting God amid weariness and contempt.

item.title: Awakening the “Divine Feminine” Is Not Biblical
item.description: The message to awaken your inner goddess is spreading rapidly across social media and New Age spirituality, yet it stands in direct opposition to biblical Christianity. This episode of New Age to Christ exposes the deception behind the so called divine feminine movement and points listeners back to worship of God alone.

item.title: Esther’s Bold Approach and God’s Unseen Providence
item.description: In Esther 5, Queen Esther steps forward in courageous faith, trusting God’s unseen providence and sovereign timing. This episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave explores courage, wisdom, pride, and how Esther’s intercession points us to Christ.
